_comment: Alert sources for jobseek run-alerts (see the setup guide phases 2-5). The registered sources' sender addresses and posting-host patterns live in the source registry (sources/registry.py) and are merged in automatically - this file only needs what the registry can't know: the owner's target employer domains, alert-subject keywords and link-skip markers. Owner-editable: add employer alert sender addresses as they arrive. No personal data belongs here - sender addresses and domains only.
